html:
Overview 

In 2025, a top-tier full-service marketing agency collaborated with MarketJoy to improve the organic search visibility of their agency and increase the volume of leads generated from their inbound lead generation efforts.

Despite a strong creative and paid media performance, the organic acquisition channel for the agency underperformed. As such, the agency experienced inconsistent organic traffic and few qualified inbound leads being generated from this channel. In response to these issues, MarketJoy was engaged by the agency to create and implement a complete SEO, AEO & GEO performance strategy that would produce more visibility, authority, and, ultimately, improved qualified inbound leads to the agency’s business.

“The partnership with MarketJoy has completely transformed our approach to organic growth. The consistent rate at which we are now receiving qualified inbound leads is changing the way we build our business pipeline. What previously seemed difficult to replicate is now easy to measure, scalable, and profitable.”

— Managing Partner, Leading Marketing Agency

The Challenge 

Before partnering with MarketJoy, the agency averaged fewer than five qualified inbound leads per month, with limited visibility across high-value, intent-driven keywords.

Their goals were clear: 

  • Increase organic visibility across core service categories
  • Improve keyword rankings for ICP (Ideal Client Profile) search terms
  • Generate consistent, high-quality inbound leads
  • Establish sustainable, data-driven growth

MarketJoy’s Impact 

Within 10 months of engagement, MarketJoy’s AI SEO program delivered measurable and transformational business results.

Through advanced site optimization, alignment of content strategy, and continuous data analysis, the agency has demonstrated extreme growth in all the major SEO metrics, resulting in new pipeline opportunities based on inbound leads.

Key Performance Results (January–October 2025)

Ranking Keywords  42  230  +447% 
Organic Impressions  7,495  70,396  +839% 
Qualified Inbound Leads  4  55  +1,275%

Business Outcomes 

✅ Sustained Visibility Growth

The agency achieved a 447% increase in keyword rankings, expanding its reach across competitive, high-intent search terms relevant to its services.

✅ Exponential Increase in Brand Exposure

Organic impressions increased by 839%, providing the agency with a consistent funnel of traffic at the discovery stage and generating brand awareness among their ideal customer prospects.

✅ Qualified Lead Generation at Scale

The most dramatic outcome was the increase of qualified inbound leads from 4 to 55 per month; an increase of 1275% within 10 months. All leads fit their ideal customer profiles, thus providing a considerable lift in both conversion rates and revenue pipeline.

✅ Sustained Pipeline Performance

By the end of Q3, organic inbound leads had outpaced paid campaigns in both conversion rates and cost per lead, providing the agency’s business development team with an inexhaustible source of inbound leads for business development.

Conclusion 

The engagement shows the effectiveness of MarketJoy’s SEO Performance Framework in resulting in productive organic channels into engines of dependable lead generation.

For this marketing agency, MarketJoy delivered not just visibility but business-qualified growth that continues to compound month over month.

MarketJoy AI SEO Services: Turning visibility into velocity for brands that want measurable, pipeline-driven growth.
